title: Since AI 2026 Shared Contracts
description: Product-boundary contracts between retrofit (AI), client (UI), and server (API). Dataset table schemas stay in retrofit/src/retrofit_sim/schema.py. Align in team chat before changing fields.

AlertPrediction.description: One scored alert row. Matches retrofit PREDICTION_SCHEMA and scoring.REQUIRED. retrofit writes CSV with these columns; client/server consume the same shape.

asset_id.description: Asset the alert refers to (e.g. PUMP-01 … PUMP-12).

alert_time_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the alert would have been raised (must only use data up to this time).

event_class.description: Predicted class: machine condition or instrument / data problem.

fault_type.description: Predicted fault type (benchmark taxonomy) or UNKNOWN.

AlertPredictionList.description: Batch of alert predictions (CSV rows or API payload).
